alexcrichton opened PR #14688 from alexcrichton:catch-exceptions to bytecodealliance:main:

This commit extends the refactoring done in #14549 to handle host-thrown exceptions in addition to guest-thrown exceptions. Effectively here the host entrypoints are now annotated with how to handle ThrownException in addition to entrypoints to ensure that host-thrown exceptions are considered traps as opposed to being caught by wasm.

Closes #14577
